title: Hearty Mustardy Indian Borlotti Beans Kheer
description: A rich and creamy Indian dessert featuring borlotti beans and a soffritto base, with a hint of mustard and ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is lightly browned.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mustard seeds and cook until they start to splutter.
Add the cooked and mashed borlotti beans and stir well.
Add the milk and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the grated jaggery, cardamom powder, and salt, and stir well.
Continue to simmer for another 5 minutes or until the kheer has thickened.
Remove from heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Serve the kheer chilled, garnished with chopped nuts or dried fruit if desired.
